title: Sleep may land easier tonight.
caption: Sleep may land easier tonight. Space looks steady with no fresh bursts, which can make it simpler to wind down without the usual bumps. If your body is still catching up, keep the evening low-key and give yourself a longer runway. — Kp 1.7 • Bz -4.9 nT • Schumann 7.70 Hz (snapshot at write time)
snapshot: Quiet geomagnetic conditions and no recent flares point to a stable backdrop. Solar wind is ordinary. This often opens a window for steadier days.
affects: People in a flare may notice symptoms ease a step, with less dramatic spikes. Stamina can feel a bit more predictable when the external load is steady. If symptoms remain loud, it may be lag from recent ups and downs or local weather stressors.
playbook:
- Keep plans modest and repeatable
- Pace early to avoid late spikes
- Gentle movement over intensity
- Check storms, pressure shifts, or allergens in your area
